observations.code_quote: - A version that changes the pagination _mechanism_ (e.g. offset→cursor, or one opaque cursor param for another, since a token one generation issued means nothing to the other) also changes the resumable checkpoint's persisted shape. Add a new defaulted field to the resume-config dataclass rather than repurposing the existing one — so state persisted under the old version still decodes — and make the seed and save-checkpoint logic dispatch on the resolved version. Reusing one field across incompatible mechanisms corrupts in-flight resumes of the other version. When a table stays on its old wire under the new pin, key the check on the wire that issued the cursor, not on the pin.
